title: Acoustic metamaterial for subwavelength edge detection

E_GUIDE.locator: Results: Metamaterial transmission properties, PDF pp2–3; Fig1a–b
E_GUIDE.facts: Five coupled symmetric resonators; square narrow/wide apertures w=7.5 mm, W=22.5 mm; axial narrow/wide lengths l=3 mm, L=15 mm; physical guide made by 3D printing

E_MODEL.locator: Results: Metamaterial transmission properties, PDF pp2–3; Fig1c–d; Fig2a–b; Eq1
E_MODEL.facts: Modal conversion, low-spatial-frequency rejection and multimodal transmission model; five predicted transmission peaks; these are theory/model results

E_RIG.locator: Methods: Experimental setup, PDF p5; Fig1a–b
E_RIG.facts: Vertical printed guide; enclosure lined with 50-mm absorbing foam; 22-mm Clarion SRE 212H speaker on longitudinal axis 280 mm from input; output absorbing foam

E_MIC.locator: Methods: Experimental setup, PDF p5; Fig1a
E_MIC.facts: Four G.R.A.S. 40BD quarter-inch (6.35-mm) microphones flush with inner wall, at each wall midpoint, 20 mm from the final narrow section; phase-sensitive complex pressure acquisition

E_MODES.facts: a00=(p1+p3)/2=(p2+p4)/2; a01=(p1-p3)/2; a10=(p2-p4)/2. Channel orientation and gain/phase calibration must remain explicit

E_CONTROL.locator: Results: Metamaterial transmission properties, PDF p3; Fig2c
E_CONTROL.facts: No-object measurement compared with an aluminium plate edge at approximately 1 mm blocking half the input aperture; three observed experimental peaks, unlike five model peaks

E_1D.locator: Results: Edge visualization, PDF pp3–4; Fig3a–c
E_1D.facts: Separate 1D scans of a single aluminium plate edge, a 32-mm-wide aluminium plate and a 10-mm-wide aluminium rod at 7,740 Hz

E_DISC.locator: Results: Edge visualization, PDF pp4–5; Fig4a–d
E_DISC.facts: 100-mm-diameter Plexiglas disc; displayed upper half; total and directional channels; reduced dynamic-range display

E_ETH.locator: Results: Edge visualization, PDF pp4–5; Fig4e–h
E_ETH.facts: Separate rigid-thermoplastic ETH target; reported letter width 15 mm and separations 10–15 mm; complete outline/thickness absent

E_SCAN.facts: Objects 1 mm before input, moved by Velmex stepper motor; 0.6-mm physical 1D steps; 1.6-mm physical 2D steps; 7,740-Hz phase reference; 2D display linearly interpolated to 0.8-mm grid

E_FE.locator: Methods: Finite elements simulations, PDF p5; Fig3a–c
E_FE.facts: COMSOL 1D comparisons; perfectly rigid object and guide in air; axial point source 280 mm away; object normal to axis 1 mm from input; exterior and output PML

E_TR.locator: Supplementary Figures1–2, PDF p1; Note1, PDF p2
E_TR.facts: Eigenmodes with PML on both extremities; listed trapped frequencies 7733,7754,7783,7812,7834 Hz; numerical, not acquired acoustic readings

E_TM.facts: Rigid-wall Helmholtz field expanded in transverse modes, straight-segment and discontinuity scattering matrices composed to obtain transmission; source states 13 scattering elements

E_LIMIT.locator: Discussion, PDF p5; Edge visualization, PDF pp3–5
E_LIMIT.facts: Published edge width and direction selectivity are observations; small-rod apparent width bias and incomplete ETH T-stem visualization limit the interpretation; possible biomedical and optical extensions are discussion only
